summary: Merge the two independently written no-fork policies into one canonical source rendered into every repository

coordination.notes: Overlaps codex-root's active claim on AGENTS.md. Two policy documents saying the same thing is the defect the policy names, so this integrates rather than chooses by author: codex-root's operating standard and ledger protocol are kept near-verbatim, and the three moves, the 'no fourth move' framing, the justification tell, and the application to prose and history were added from the Claude side. Nothing was deleted; what lands here is a superset of what was here. Canonical source is now ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md section 0, rendered by dev/claude-config/stamp-rules.py into CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md in each repository, so the copies cannot drift. The ledger section is stamped only into repositories that actually contain .agents/, since a mandatory check-in protocol pointing at a missing directory is an instruction to nowhere. Deduplicated by git remote: ~44 dr-companion worktrees under Documents/Codex were deliberately not stamped, because committing one policy 44 times into one repository is the fork this rule forbids. Authorized by Dan directly, 3 Sep 2026: 'ab compare and decide which is better or if they need combined somehow and then kill the duplicates'.
